entities.summary:
Han Gan was a Chinese painter during the Tang dynasty. His artistic style blended traditional techniques with innovative brushwork, influencing generations of Chinese painters. The Tang court valued art as a means of patronage and cultural expression, commissioning works from prominent artists like Han Gan.

As one of the most celebrated artists of his time, Han Gan's works were highly sought after by royalty and nobility. His paintings adorned the walls of palaces and temples, serving as a testament to the Tang dynasty's rich cultural heritage.

Despite the passing of centuries, Han Gan's legacy endures. His artistic innovations paved the way for future generations of Chinese painters, ensuring his name remains synonymous with excellence in traditional Chinese art.
